blocks.zh: 品質管控 — 無菌試驗、參數放行與快速微生物方法
blocks.en: Quality Control: Sterility Testing, Parametric Release and Rapid Microbial Methods

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解無菌試驗 (Sterility Testing) 在無菌保證體系中的正確定位：它是最後一道防線，而非主要的保證工具
blocks.en: Understand the correct role of sterility testing within the sterility assurance system: it is the last line of defence, not the primary assurance tool

blocks.zh: 掌握微生物負荷 (Bioburden) 測試的要求，包括無菌充填批次與終端滅菌批次的差異
blocks.en: Master the bioburden testing requirements, including the differences between aseptically filled batches and terminally sterilised batches

blocks.zh: 了解參數放行 (Parametric Release) 的前提條件與 bioburden 監控程序設計
blocks.en: Understand the prerequisites for parametric release and the design of the bioburden monitoring programme

blocks.zh: 認識環境監測數據在批次放行審查中的角色，以及快速微生物方法 (Rapid Microbial Methods) 的應用情境
blocks.en: Recognise the role of environmental monitoring data in batch release review, and when rapid microbial methods are applied

blocks.zh: 掌握 QC 培養基的品質測試要求與 APS 媒介品質測試規定
blocks.en: Master the quality testing requirements for QC culture media and the requirements for media quality testing in APS

blocks.zh: 10.1 – 10.2 人員與規格要求
blocks.en: 10.1 – 10.2 Personnel and Specification Requirements

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: QC 部門在無菌製造中的雙重角色：PIC/S Annex 1 Section 10 開門見山要求 QC 人員必須具備微生物學、無菌保證、製程知識三項核心能力。這不只是測試結果的接受與拒絕，而是參與設計（EM 制度設計）、調查（微生物事件根本原因分析）的主動角色。
blocks.en: The dual role of the QC department in sterile manufacturing: Section 10 of PIC/S Annex 1 opens by requiring that QC personnel have core competence in three areas: microbiology, sterility assurance and process knowledge. This is not just about accepting or rejecting test results; it is an active role in designing (the EM programme) and investigating (root cause analysis of microbiological events).

blocks.zh: 污染控制策略 (CCS，Contamination Control Strategy) 是 Annex 1 2022 年版的核心新增概念。Section 2 定義 CCS，而 Section 10.2 強調：物料規格中是否需要設定微生物/顆粒/內毒素限度，必須由 CCS 驅動，而非由傳統習慣決定。
blocks.en: The Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) is a core new concept in the 2022 version of Annex 1. Section 2 defines the CCS, and Section 10.2 stresses that whether microbial, particulate or endotoxin limits need to be set in material specifications must be driven by the CCS, not by traditional habit.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像醫院的感染控制小組：他們不只是在患者感染後才介入，而是主動設計隔離制度、訂定清潔頻率、審查環境數據——這正是 QC 微生物學家在無菌工廠中的角色。CCS 就是那份完整的「感染管控計畫 (Hospital Infection Control Plan)」，規格限度是其中明確的行動觸發點。
blocks.en: Think of a hospital infection control team. They do not step in only after a patient is infected; they proactively design isolation arrangements, set cleaning frequencies and review environmental data. This is exactly the role of the QC microbiologist in a sterile facility. The CCS is the complete "Hospital Infection Control Plan", and specification limits are its clear action trigger points.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 10.2 的「when the need has been indicated by monitoring and/or CCS」是關鍵句——它意味著不是所有物料都需要設微生物限度，但一旦 CCS 評估認為有必要，就必須納入規格。這是 risk-based approach (基於風險的方法) 的體現，而非一刀切。
blocks.en: The key phrase in 10.2 is "when the need has been indicated by monitoring and/or CCS". It means that not every material needs a microbial limit, but once the CCS assessment concludes one is needed, it must be included in the specification. This reflects a risk-based approach, not a one-size-fits-all rule.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 工廠中，QC 微生物學家是否參與了 EM 制度的設計，或只是執行測試？兩者有何本質差異？
blocks.en: In your CDMO facility, do QC microbiologists take part in designing the EM programme, or do they only perform the tests? What is the fundamental difference between the two?

blocks.zh: 若一種輔料的供應商已提供微生物限度規格，你是否還需要在自己的規格中再定義？CCS 如何幫助你做這個決定？
blocks.en: If an excipient supplier already provides a microbial limit specification, do you still need to define one in your own specification? How does the CCS help you make this decision?

blocks.zh: 10.3 – 10.4 Bioburden 測試要求
blocks.en: 10.3 – 10.4 Bioburden Testing Requirements

blocks.zh: 微生物負荷 (Bioburden)：指在滅菌前，特定物品（如灌裝後的產品）上存在的微生物總量。Bioburden 不是汙染指標，而是一個關鍵的製程輸入參數：滅菌效率是以初始 bioburden 為基礎計算的。
blocks.en: Bioburden is the total amount of microorganisms present on a given item (for example, a filled product) before sterilisation. Bioburden is not a contamination indicator but a critical process input parameter: sterilisation efficiency is calculated on the basis of the initial bioburden.

blocks.zh: 為什麼每批都要做？ 10.3 要求 both 無菌充填與終端滅菌產品每批次都執行 bioburden。這與 overkill 製程的邏輯不同——overkill 可降低頻率（定期），但標準製程（non-overkill）必須每批監控。
blocks.en: Why test every batch? Section 10.3 requires bioburden testing for both aseptically filled and terminally sterilised products on every batch. This differs from the logic of an overkill process: an overkill process may reduce the frequency (periodic testing), but a standard (non-overkill) process must be monitored every batch.

blocks.zh: 參數放行 (Parametric Release)：以製程參數（溫度、時間、壓力等）替代無菌試驗作為放行依據。只有在製程已充分驗證、且每批 bioburden 受控的前提下才被允許。這是最高等級的製程理解與信任。
blocks.en: Parametric Release means using process parameters (temperature, time, pressure, etc.) instead of the sterility test as the basis for release. It is permitted only when the process has been thoroughly validated and bioburden is controlled for every batch. This represents the highest level of process understanding and trust.

blocks.zh: 公式與概念 Bioburden 與 SAL 的關係
blocks.en: Formula and Concept: Relationship between Bioburden and SAL

blocks.zh:
目標 SAL (Sterility Assurance Level) = 10⁻⁶

SAL = 初始 Bioburden × e^(-D × t/D-value)

更直觀地理解：
  若初始 bioburden = 1 CFU/unit
  → 需要 6-log reduction 達到 SAL 10⁻⁶

  若初始 bioburden = 100 CFU/unit
  → 需要 8-log reduction 達到 SAL 10⁻⁶

結論：bioburden 越高，達到相同 SAL 所需的
滅菌強度越大，或信心越低。
blocks.en:
Target SAL (Sterility Assurance Level) = 10⁻⁶

SAL = Initial Bioburden × e^(-D × t/D-value)

A more intuitive way to look at it:
  If initial bioburden = 1 CFU/unit
  → a 6-log reduction is needed to reach SAL 10⁻⁶

  If initial bioburden = 100 CFU/unit
  → an 8-log reduction is needed to reach SAL 10⁻⁶

Conclusion: the higher the bioburden, the greater the
sterilisation intensity needed to reach the same SAL,
or the lower the confidence.

blocks.zh: 取樣代表 worst case：10.3 強調樣品必須代表最壞情況，例如在 hold time 最末期取樣。這是因為微生物在等待時間內可能持續增殖，end-of-hold 是批次中 bioburden 最高的時間點。
blocks.en: Sampling must represent the worst case: Section 10.3 stresses that samples must represent the worst case, for example samples taken at the end of the hold time. Microorganisms may continue to multiply during the waiting period, so the end of the hold is the point at which bioburden in the batch is highest.

blocks.zh: Parametric release 的額外義務（10.4）：找到的菌株必須鑑定 (identified)，並評估其對滅菌效率的影響。耐熱菌（如芽孢桿菌）的存在，即使數量少，也可能危及 SAL 計算的有效性。
blocks.en: Additional obligations for parametric release (10.4): Isolates found must be identified and their impact on sterilisation efficiency assessed. The presence of heat-resistant organisms (such as Bacillus spores), even in small numbers, may compromise the validity of the SAL calculation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：客戶產品使用 121°C / 15 分鐘蒸汽滅菌（non-overkill）。你需要在 validation 階段建立 bioburden 限度（通常 ≤ 10 CFU/100 mL），並在每批灌裝後、啟動滅菌前取樣確認。如果某批 bioburden 超標，不能直接放行滅菌——必須調查原因並評估風險，可能需要拒批。這正是 bioburden data 進入批次放行決策的方式。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: the client's product uses steam sterilisation at 121°C for 15 minutes (non-overkill). During validation you need to establish a bioburden limit (typically ≤ 10 CFU/100 mL), and confirm it by sampling after each batch is filled and before sterilisation starts. If a batch exceeds the bioburden limit, it cannot simply proceed to sterilisation and release; you must investigate the cause and assess the risk, and the batch may need to be rejected. This is how bioburden data enters the batch release decision.

blocks.zh: 10.5 – 10.8 無菌試驗的正確定位
blocks.en: 10.5 – 10.8 The Correct Role of Sterility Testing

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 最重要的概念轉變
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Most Important Shift in Thinking

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗 (Sterility Testing) 不能保證無菌！ 這是許多從業者最容易誤解的地方。10.5 的邏輯是：
blocks.en: Sterility testing cannot guarantee sterility! This is the point many practitioners misunderstand most easily. The logic of 10.5 is as follows:

blocks.zh: 一批 10,000 支產品，隨機取 20 支做無菌試驗
blocks.en: In a batch of 10,000 units, 20 are randomly sampled for sterility testing

blocks.zh: 即使所有 20 支都通過，仍有 9,980 支未被測試
blocks.en: Even if all 20 pass, 9,980 units remain untested

blocks.zh: 統計學上，如果汙染率為 0.1%，這 20 支樣本仍有約 98% 機率全部通過
blocks.en: Statistically, if the contamination rate is 0.1%, these 20 samples still have about a 98% probability of all passing

blocks.zh: 因此，無菌試驗是「確認型」的最後一步，而非「保障型」的主要防線。真正的無菌保證來自製程設計、驗證、與持續管控。
blocks.en: Sterility testing is therefore a "confirmatory" final step, not the primary "protective" line of defence. True sterility assurance comes from process design, validation and ongoing control.

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗就像餐廳最後上桌前試吃一口湯——它能告訴你這口鹹不鹹，但不能保證整鍋都沒問題。真正保障食品安全的是廚師的訓練、廚房的衛生環境、原料的新鮮度，以及標準化的烹調製程。試吃只是最後的確認，不是品質的來源。
blocks.en: Sterility testing is like tasting a spoonful of soup just before the restaurant serves it. It can tell you whether that spoonful is salty, but it cannot guarantee that the whole pot is fine. What really protects food safety is the chef's training, the hygiene of the kitchen, the freshness of the ingredients and a standardised cooking process. Tasting is only a final confirmation, not the source of quality.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 取樣策略
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Sampling Strategy

blocks.zh: 10.6 的取樣設計原則：樣品必須代表「最高風險時間點與位置」：
blocks.en: Sampling design principles in 10.6: samples must represent the "highest-risk time points and locations":

blocks.zh: 無菌充填：批次開始（設備剛暴露）和結束（長時間暴露後）是風險最高點；關鍵干預後也應額外取樣。
blocks.en: Aseptic filling: the start of the batch (equipment just exposed) and the end (after prolonged exposure) are the highest-risk points; additional samples should also be taken after critical interventions.

blocks.zh: 熱滅菌：滅菌釜中最冷點或加熱最慢的位置——這些點的 SAL 最低，代表批次的最壞情況。
blocks.en: Heat sterilisation: the cold spot in the autoclave or the slowest-heating location. These points have the lowest SAL and represent the worst case for the batch.

blocks.zh: 凍乾：不同凍乾批次的樣品，因為不同 load 的熱分佈可能不同。
blocks.en: Freeze-drying: samples from different freeze-drying batches, because heat distribution may differ between loads.

blocks.zh: 短貨架期產品 (10.7) 的替代策略
blocks.en: Alternative Strategies for Short Shelf-Life Products (10.7)

blocks.zh:
標準無菌試驗：需時 14 天（薄膜過濾法）
問題：若產品 shelf life 僅 24-48 小時（如放射性藥物）
→ 無菌試驗完成前產品已過期！

替代方案（須文件化評估）：
  1. 強化製程驗證（更頻繁的 APS）
  2. 增加即時環境監測
  3. 快速微生物方法 (Rapid Microbial Methods)
     例如：螢光技術、ATP 生物發光法（2-4 小時出結果）
  4. 參數放行（若適用）
blocks.en:
Standard sterility test: takes 14 days (membrane filtration method)
Problem: if the product shelf life is only 24-48 hours (e.g. radiopharmaceuticals)
→ the product expires before the sterility test is complete!

Alternatives (require a documented assessment):
  1. Enhanced process validation (more frequent APS)
  2. Increased real-time environmental monitoring
  3. Rapid Microbial Methods
     e.g. fluorescence techniques, ATP bioluminescence (results in 2-4 hours)
  4. Parametric release (where applicable)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — VHP 去汙不得損害試驗靈敏度 (10.8)
blocks.en: Key Notes: VHP Decontamination Must Not Compromise Test Sensitivity (10.8)

blocks.zh: 在樣品外表面使用 Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide (VHP) 或紫外線去汙時，必須驗證這些處理不會滲入容器或殘留後影響培養基。如果去汙步驟殺死了真正存在的微生物，無菌試驗就成為「假陰性」的來源——這比沒有試驗更危險，因為給了虛假的安全感。
blocks.en: When Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide (VHP) or ultraviolet light is used to decontaminate the outer surface of samples, it must be verified that these treatments do not penetrate into the container or leave residues that affect the culture medium. If the decontamination step kills microorganisms that are actually present, the sterility test becomes a source of "false negatives". This is more dangerous than having no test at all, because it creates a false sense of security.

blocks.zh: 一個批次的無菌試驗失敗了（Sterility Test Failure, STF）。監管要求首先確認是「實驗室差錯」還是真正的批次問題。為什麼無菌試驗失敗不能直接等同於「這批產品不無菌」？反之，無菌試驗通過是否意味著「這批產品一定無菌」？
blocks.en: A batch has failed its sterility test (Sterility Test Failure, STF). Regulators require you to first establish whether it is a "laboratory error" or a genuine batch problem. Why can a sterility test failure not be directly equated with "this batch is not sterile"? Conversely, does a passing sterility test mean that "this batch is definitely sterile"?

blocks.zh: 一個無菌充填批次，共灌裝 50,000 支，分成上午班和下午班各 25,000 支。取樣策略應如何設計才符合 10.6 的要求？
blocks.en: An aseptically filled batch of 50,000 units is split into a morning shift and an afternoon shift of 25,000 units each. How should the sampling strategy be designed to meet the requirements of 10.6?

blocks.zh: 10.9 – 10.11 培養基品質測試與 EM 數據審查
blocks.en: 10.9 – 10.11 Culture Media Quality Testing and EM Data Review

blocks.zh: Local isolates (在地分離菌株)：EM 培養基的 growth promotion testing 不只用藥典標準菌株，還必須納入你工廠實際環境中分離出的菌株。這是因為工廠特有的微生物可能對培養條件有特殊需求——若培養基對它們的生長不靈敏，EM 的假陰性率就會升高。
blocks.en: Local isolates: growth promotion testing of EM culture media should use not only the pharmacopoeial standard strains but also strains isolated from your own facility environment. Organisms specific to a facility may have particular culture requirements, and if the medium is not sensitive to their growth, the false-negative rate of EM will increase.

blocks.zh: 環境監測數據作為批次放行的一部分 (10.10)：這是 Annex 1 2022 年版的強化要求。EM 數據不只是環境管理的工具，而是批次放行決策的輸入。QP（Qualified Person，品質授權人）在簽署批次放行時，必須已審查相關的 EM 趨勢數據。
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring data as part of batch release (10.10): this is a strengthened requirement in the 2022 version of Annex 1. EM data is not only a tool for environmental management but also an input to the batch release decision. When signing off batch release, the QP (Qualified Person) must have reviewed the relevant EM trend data.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — Out of Trend (OOT) vs. Out of Specification (OOS)
blocks.en: Key Notes: Out of Trend (OOT) vs. Out of Specification (OOS)

blocks.zh: OOT（超趨勢）：數據未超過行動限，但顯示上升趨勢——這是早期警告信號。Alert level 用於觸發 OOT 調查。OOS（超規格）：超過 Action limit，需要立即調查並採取糾正措施 (CAPA)。10.10 要求兩種情況都必須有書面程序規定後續行動。
blocks.en: OOT (out of trend): data does not exceed the action limit but shows an upward trend, which is an early warning signal. The alert level is used to trigger an OOT investigation. OOS (out of specification): the action limit is exceeded, requiring immediate investigation and corrective action (CAPA). Section 10.10 requires written procedures defining the follow-up actions for both situations.

blocks.zh: 快速方法 (Rapid Microbial Methods, RMM) 的驗證要求 (10.11)：方法必須針對你的具體產品或製程驗證，不能僅依賴廠商的通用驗證數據。驗證應包括：靈敏度、特異性、基質效應評估。
blocks.en: Validation requirements for Rapid Microbial Methods (RMM) (10.11): the method must be validated for your specific product or process and cannot rely solely on the vendor's generic validation data. Validation should include sensitivity, specificity and an assessment of matrix effects.

blocks.zh: 培養基的 growth promotion testing 就像廚師在開餐前確認爐子能正常點火——如果爐子根本燒不起來，所有食材的「新鮮度測試」結果都毫無意義。Local isolates 的加入，就像用你家廚房常見的食材來測試，而不是用從沒見過的異國食材。
blocks.en: Growth promotion testing of culture media is like a chef checking that the stove lights properly before service. If the stove cannot light at all, the results of every "freshness test" on the ingredients are meaningless. Adding local isolates is like testing with ingredients commonly found in your own kitchen rather than exotic ingredients you have never seen.

blocks.zh: CDMO 批次放行流程整合：在設計批次放行 (Batch Certification) 的 SOP 時，必須明確定義：哪些 EM 數據必須完整且在規格內，才能放行？通常包括：（1）灌裝期間的 Grade A 連續顆粒監測趨勢；（2）灌裝當週的 Grade B/C viable 採樣結果；（3）灌裝日期前後的操作人員監測結果。若數據顯示 OOT，不一定要拒批，但必須有書面評估說明為何這對產品風險可接受。
blocks.en: Integration into the CDMO batch release process: when designing the Batch Certification SOP, you must clearly define which EM data must be complete and within specification before release is allowed. This usually includes: (1) the continuous Grade A particle monitoring trend during filling; (2) the Grade B/C viable sampling results for the week of filling; (3) the personnel monitoring results around the filling date. If the data show an OOT, the batch does not necessarily have to be rejected, but there must be a written assessment explaining why the product risk is acceptable.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠引入了 ATP 生物發光法 (ATP bioluminescence) 作為 EM 的快速方法。根據 10.11，你需要做哪些驗證工作才能用於批次放行決策？
blocks.en: Your facility has introduced ATP bioluminescence as a rapid method for EM. According to 10.11, what validation work do you need to do before it can be used for batch release decisions?

blocks.zh: 一個批次在製造後，Grade C 區域有一次 OOT（超趨勢但未超 Alert level）的環境監測結果。QP 可以放行嗎？需要什麼文件支持？
blocks.en: After a batch is manufactured, there is one OOT environmental monitoring result (out of trend but not exceeding the alert level) in a Grade C area. Can the QP release the batch? What documentation is needed to support this?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗的根本限制：無菌試驗 (Sterility Testing) 是系列管控措施中「最後一步」，在統計上無法保證整批無菌；真正的無菌保證來自製程設計、驗證與持續管控
blocks.en: The fundamental limitation of sterility testing: sterility testing is the "last step" in a series of control measures and statistically cannot guarantee that a whole batch is sterile; true sterility assurance comes from process design, validation and ongoing control

blocks.zh: Bioburden 是製程參數，不只是測試：每批都需執行，結果必須納入批次放行審查；bioburden 限度由滅菌方法的效率決定，並反映 SAL 計算的有效性
blocks.en: Bioburden is a process parameter, not just a test: it must be performed for every batch and the results must be included in batch release review; the bioburden limit is determined by the efficiency of the sterilisation method and reflects the validity of the SAL calculation

blocks.zh: 參數放行的前提：必須有完整的 pre-sterilisation bioburden 監控程序，且菌株需要鑑定並評估對滅菌的影響
blocks.en: Prerequisites for parametric release: a complete pre-sterilisation bioburden monitoring programme must be in place, and isolates must be identified and assessed for their impact on sterilisation

blocks.zh: EM 數據是批次放行的輸入：QP 在放行前必須審查 EM 趨勢數據；OOT 和 OOS 都必須有書面的後續行動程序
blocks.en: EM data is an input to batch release: the QP must review EM trend data before release; both OOT and OOS must have written follow-up action procedures

blocks.zh: 培養基品質測試必須包含 local isolates：以確保 EM 對工廠特有微生物的靈敏度；供應商測試不能直接替代 end user 測試
blocks.en: Media quality testing must include local isolates: to ensure that EM is sensitive to organisms specific to the facility; supplier testing cannot directly replace end user testing

blocks.zh: 快速微生物方法需針對產品驗證：通用驗證不足，必須評估基質效應，且對短貨架期產品具有特殊重要性
blocks.en: Rapid microbial methods must be validated for the product: generic validation is not sufficient, matrix effects must be assessed, and this is of particular importance for short shelf-life products
